_meta.coordinateNote: lat/lng are approximate village centres in WGS84; confidence: high = well-known locality, unambiguous name; medium = correct locality but coordinate or Hungarian spelling to double-check; low = identification of the historical name itself should be verified.
_meta.matching: normalise with fold(): NFD, strip diacritics, lowercase, non-alphanumerics -> space. Lookup order: modern name, historical name, aliases; a county hint (modern or historical) breaks ties.
_meta.regionNote: Region follows the usual modern convention: Bihor, Arad, Satu Mare, Salaj -> Crisana; Timis, Caras-Severin -> Banat; Maramures -> Maramures; the rest -> Transylvania. Historical county assignment uses the pre-1920 Hungarian county the site is likely to print.
_meta.status: SEED - all coordinates are approximate (2 decimals, roughly +-1 km) and were entered from general knowledge, not from an authoritative source. Verify every entry against the scraped data (site place names, the bartok-nepzene /en/map/ page if it exposes coordinates) before relying on it for the map.
